_comment: Default configuration for the journal addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_system_category: #1507 — the journal's own system-category and vault, pages/vaults/{user}/journal/, declared here rather than in core config. Core reads this entry live whether the add-on is on or off (#1559), so journal pages and vaults stay reachable when it is turned off. owner, encrypt, defaultPrivate and shareMaxDays are the journal's declaration: a site's app-custom-config.json cannot change them (it gets a warning). Values unchanged from the entry core shipped before #1507.

journal.label: journal
journal.description: Personal journal entries — schema.org BlogPosting at JSON-LD render time (#791)

_comment_journal_permissions: #1430 — the journal declares the permissions its routes ask for: journal-read (list and view one's own entries), journal-write (create, edit, delete, settings) and journal-export (bulk JSON/Markdown export, separable like core's page-export). Delegated on day one to every role that can sign in, so nobody loses access; a deployment narrows it in app-custom-config.json by overriding journal-access or adding a deny policy.

journal-read.description: View your own journal: the entry list, entries, tags, moods, on-this-day and streak
journal-read.label: Read your own journal

journal-write.description: Write, edit and delete your own journal entries and change your journal settings
journal-write.label: Write and edit your own journal

journal-export.description: Export your whole journal as JSON or Markdown
journal-export.label: Export your own journal
